Description: Food employees must wash hands and exposed arms
TypicalCorrectiveAction: Retrain staff on proper handwashing procedures

Description: Food must be from approved sources
TypicalCorrectiveAction: Remove unapproved food sources and verify supplier credentials

Description: Potentially hazardous food must be at proper holding temperature
TypicalCorrectiveAction: Adjust refrigeration equipment and monitor temperatures

Description: Food contact surfaces must be clean and sanitized
TypicalCorrectiveAction: Clean and sanitize all food contact surfaces immediately

Description: Food employees must wear proper hair restraints
TypicalCorrectiveAction: Provide proper hair nets and training to staff

Description: Premises must be maintained free of insects and rodents
TypicalCorrectiveAction: Implement pest control program and seal entry points

Description: Raw animal foods must be stored separately from ready-to-eat foods
Manual warewashing equipment must be properly maintained
Food containers must be properly labeled with dates
TypicalCorrectiveAction: Label all food containers with preparation and discard dates
